title: Forgetting this will RUIN your deal
description:
Overlooking leases during due diligence can wreck your deal faster than you think. In this video, we dive into why leases—on property, equipment, or even software—are a critical part of the business you’re buying. From hidden costs and unfavorable terms to surprise renewals and landlord approvals, forgetting to fully review lease agreements can lead to financial headaches or even kill the deal entirely.

We’ll walk through real-world examples of how lease issues blindsided buyers, what to look for in lease documents, and how to handle lease transfers or renegotiations before closing. Whether it's a retail space or a warehouse, leases can carry serious liabilities if not addressed up front. Don’t let this avoidable mistake cost you the business.
